description: Source-backed authoring, baking, normalization, runtime lookup, and rendering contract for FOnline text packs and prototype-localized text.

scope.support_note: The contract is generated for a pinned Engine revision. Projects own language policy, pack catalogs, translation workflow, semantic key conventions, and any game-specific lexem or argument formatter.
included: .fotxt file naming, brace-field syntax, multiline values, structured keys, and duplicate variants
BakeLanguages ordering, incremental rebakes, bake-time language normalization, and binary output names
$Text prototype fields, inheritance, output-pack routing, escape decoding, and validation
client and server script lookup surfaces, language switching, and inline renderer color tags
excluded: project language priorities, translation ownership, terminology, and release-readiness policy
project-specific lexems, argument substitution, random-choice syntax, dialog formatting, and chat wrappers
concrete pack names beyond the five Engine-generated prototype packs
font selection, layout, shaping, and general GUI authoring

syntax_rules.name: Raw entry shape
syntax_rules.requirement: A parsed .fotxt entry contains Key1, Key2, and Text in three brace-delimited fields; the collection is the text-pack filename segment.
syntax_rules.rationale: LoadFromString supplies the collection separately and constructs TextPackKey from the two authored key fields.

syntax_rules.name: Structured key identity
syntax_rules.requirement: TextPackKey identity is Collection plus Key1, Key2, and Key3, each represented as a hashed string wrapper.
syntax_rules.rationale: Raw .fotxt entries leave Key3 empty, while prototype $Text fields may populate Key2 and Key3.

syntax_rules.name: Multiline value
syntax_rules.requirement: Only the third field may continue across physical lines; joined lines retain newline characters until the first closing brace.
syntax_rules.rationale: The first two ExtractBraceToken calls disable multiline input and the third enables it.

syntax_rules.name: No comment grammar
syntax_rules.requirement: The parser skips a physical line only when it cannot find the first opening brace; comment conventions are project policy and comment text must not contain parseable brace fields.
syntax_rules.rationale: LoadFromString has no comment-token branch and begins parsing at the first opening brace anywhere on the line.

syntax_rules.name: Required and optional fields
syntax_rules.requirement: The collection and Key1 must be non-empty; Key2 and Text may be empty.
syntax_rules.rationale: The parser rejects only an empty collection or first key after all three fields were extracted.

syntax_rules.name: Duplicate-key variants
syntax_rules.requirement: Multiple entries may share the same complete TextPackKey and remain ordered variants in the baked multimap.
syntax_rules.rationale: Variant count and indexed selection are explicit runtime operations; duplicate cardinality is not language-normalized.

syntax_rules.name: Closing-brace boundary
syntax_rules.requirement: The first closing brace terminates each field; the raw format has no escape sequence for a literal closing brace inside Text.
syntax_rules.rationale: ExtractBraceToken searches directly for the next closing brace and does not decode escapes.

language_rules.name: Source filename
language_rules.requirement: A .fotxt basename contains exactly two dot-separated segments: text-pack name and language identifier.
language_rules.rationale: TextBaker rejects every other basename shape.

anchors: Text filename must contain pack name and language suffix

language_rules.name: Language identifier
language_rules.requirement: The Engine treats the filename suffix as an opaque configured string and imposes no fixed character count.
language_rules.rationale: Acceptance is equality against Baking.BakeLanguages; no length or locale-shape validator exists in TextBaker.

language_rules.name: Base language
language_rules.requirement: Baking.BakeLanguages must be non-empty and its first entry is the base language used for normalization.
language_rules.rationale: Both text bakers reject an empty list and TextPack::FixPacks normalizes every later language against the first pack set.

language_rules.name: Base source required
language_rules.requirement: For every changed raw text pack, the selected file set must contain the base-language source.
language_rules.rationale: TextBaker cannot normalize a changed pack without the base language and throws before parsing output.

language_rules.name: Incremental pack completion
language_rules.requirement: When one language file of a text pack changes, TextBaker includes every configured language file for that same pack in the rebake.
language_rules.rationale: A partial language update must still pass complete-pack normalization.

anchors: // Ensure full language set for changed text packs

language_rules.name: Unsupported language
language_rules.requirement: A raw text file whose suffix is absent from Baking.BakeLanguages is warned and skipped.
language_rules.rationale: Unsupported raw languages do not create binary packs.

language_rules.name: Bake-time fallback
language_rules.requirement: Missing language packs and missing keys are copied from the base language during baking; packs and keys absent from the base are removed from non-base languages.
language_rules.rationale: Runtime lookup loads already-normalized binary packs and does not perform fallback.

anchors: // Remove packs that are not in the base language pack
// Add packs that are in the base language pack but not in this pack
// Normalize texts to the base language

language_rules.name: Variant cardinality
language_rules.requirement: Normalization aligns key presence, not the number or ordering of duplicate variants under an existing key.
language_rules.rationale: FixStr tests only whether a key count is zero and preserves all existing variants when the key exists.

language_rules.name: Baked filename
language_rules.requirement: Raw and prototype text bakers emit <ResourcePack>.<TextPack>.<Language>.fotxt-bin.
language_rules.rationale: TextPack::LoadFromResources later requires exactly those three basename segments.

anchors: Baked text filename must contain pack prefix, text pack name and language suffix

proto_text_rules.name: Prototype text key
proto_text_rules.requirement: Prototype text uses $Text [Language] [Key2] [Key3] = Value and accepts at most four key tokens including $Text.
proto_text_rules.rationale: The prototype id becomes Key1 and the optional trailing tokens become Key2 and Key3.

anchors: Prototype text key has too many tokens

proto_text_rules.name: Omitted language
proto_text_rules.requirement: When the language token is omitted, a $Text field belongs to the first Baking.BakeLanguages entry.
proto_text_rules.rationale: The same ordered base-language contract is shared with raw text packs.

proto_text_rules.name: Escaped value decoding
proto_text_rules.requirement: Prototype $Text values pass through StringEscaping::DecodeString before entering the text pack.
proto_text_rules.rationale: Sequences such as \n become actual newline characters in the baked value.

proto_text_rules.name: Inherited text
proto_text_rules.requirement: Parent $Text fields are merged recursively before the child fields.
proto_text_rules.rationale: A child inherits missing exact text keys while its own exact key assignment replaces the inherited value.

proto_text_rules.name: Generated pack routing
proto_text_rules.requirement: Item, Critter, Map, and Location prototypes route to Items, Critters, Maps, and Locations; other non-exported HasProtos entity or fixed types route to Protos.
proto_text_rules.rationale: These five names are the reusable Engine-generated prototype text-pack set.

proto_text_rules.name: Complete output set
proto_text_rules.requirement: ProtoTextBaker creates all five generated packs for every configured language, including empty packs.
proto_text_rules.rationale: The binary output shape is deterministic across projects and language sets.

proto_text_rules.name: Cross-type intersections
proto_text_rules.requirement: Two prototype sources may not emit the same complete key into one generated pack and language.
proto_text_rules.rationale: Intersections are counted as errors and abort prototype text baking.

anchors: throw ProtoTextBakerException("Errors during proto texts parsing")

proto_text_rules.name: Unsupported prototype language
proto_text_rules.requirement: A $Text language absent from Baking.BakeLanguages is warned and omitted.
proto_text_rules.rationale: Prototype-localized text follows the configured output-language set.

anchors: WriteLog(LogType::Warning, "Unsupported language {} in proto {}", proto_text.first, pid);

runtime_methods.name: Game.GetLanguage
runtime_methods.behavior: Returns the current Engine Language setting as a strong LanguageName wrapper.

runtime_methods.name: Game.GetText current language
runtime_methods.behavior: Returns the first variant from the current client language.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: A missing key returns an empty string.

anchors: FO_SCRIPT_API string Client_Game_GetText(ptr<ClientEngine> client, TextPackKey textKey)

runtime_methods.name: Game.GetText indexed current language
runtime_methods.behavior: Returns the zero-based variant selected by textIndex from the current client language.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: A missing key or out-of-range index returns an empty string; a negative index throws.

anchors: FO_SCRIPT_API string Client_Game_GetText(ptr<ClientEngine> client, TextPackKey textKey, int32_t textIndex)
Text index arg must not be negative

runtime_methods.name: Game.GetText explicit language
runtime_methods.behavior: An empty langName or the current language uses the current pack; another langName loads or reuses a cached pack and returns its first variant.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: An absent or unsupported non-empty language has no automatic fallback and therefore yields an empty string for the key.

anchors: FO_SCRIPT_API string Client_Game_GetText(ptr<ClientEngine> client, string_view langName, TextPackKey textKey)

runtime_methods.name: Game.GetTextCount
runtime_methods.behavior: Returns the number of variants stored under the complete key.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: Returns zero when the key is absent.

runtime_methods.name: Game.IsTextPresent
runtime_methods.behavior: Reports whether at least one variant exists under the complete key.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: Returns false when the key is absent.

runtime_methods.name: Game.ChangeLanguage
runtime_methods.behavior: Loads langName into the current client pack and writes the Language setting.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: The Engine does not validate the identifier, apply another fallback, or invoke a project GUI refresh callback.

runtime_methods.name: Server text boundary
runtime_methods.behavior: The server loads one pack for Settings.Language and exposes presence and count queries.
runtime_methods.missing_behavior: There is no server script Game.GetText overload in the Engine API.

rendering_rules.name: Inline color tags
rendering_rules.requirement: The client font renderer recognizes @color:HEX@ to push a six- or eight-hex-digit color and @color@ to restore the previous color.
rendering_rules.rationale: Color tags are renderer syntax, independent from text-pack parsing and project lexem formatting.

rendering_rules.name: NoColorize
rendering_rules.requirement: FontFlag.NoColorize strips valid inline color tags while rendering all glyphs with the base color.
rendering_rules.rationale: The formatting pass always removes recognized tags, but writes per-glyph colors only when colorization is enabled.

validation_rules.name: Malformed raw text
validation_rules.requirement: A raw source with a missing required field or unterminated value fails the text bake even if other entries parsed successfully.
validation_rules.rationale: LoadFromString reports aggregate failure and TextBaker rejects the complete source file.

validation_rules.name: Empty BakeLanguages
validation_rules.requirement: TextBaker, ProtoTextBaker, and TextPack normalization reject an empty Baking.BakeLanguages list.
validation_rules.rationale: No deterministic base language can be selected.

anchors: Text pack normalization cannot choose a base language because BakeLanguages is empty

validation_rules.name: Unsupported raw language warning
validation_rules.requirement: Unsupported raw language files produce a warning and no output for that language.
validation_rules.rationale: Projects can keep unrelated sources in a broader input tree without silently publishing them.

validation_rules.name: Prototype key token count
validation_rules.requirement: A prototype $Text key with more than Language, Key2, and Key3 after $Text fails baking.
validation_rules.rationale: TextPackKey has no additional key field.

anchors: Prototype text key has too many tokens

validation_rules.name: Prototype output intersection
validation_rules.requirement: Duplicate complete keys produced by different prototype type sources in one output pack fail baking.
validation_rules.rationale: The generated pack must not depend on iteration order across type catalogs.
